title.narrative: Advancing Women’s Rights and Leadership for Inclusive Governance in Tigray, Miachew and Enda Mekoni Wereda

description.narrative: The project is part of the EU CSF Plus Programme titled “Strengthening the Capacities of Grassroots CSOs in Ethiopia.” It aims to strengthen women’s leadership and participation in local governance structures in Miachew and Miachew and Enda Mekoni Woreda, thereby advancing inclusive development, enhancing social accountability, and fostering civic space recovery through capacity building, rights awareness, and socio-economic empowerment initiatives. Strengthen women’s skills in leadership, negotiation, and civic engagement through structured training and mentorship programs for 50 women, youth and PWDs disaggregated by age group (18–30, 31–45, 46+). Promote awareness local leaders on women’s rights and governance participation and inclusion through community dialogues and engagements with local leaders To establish and strengthen 10 women-led self-help groups and 10 small business initiatives that promote socio-economic empowerment, survivor center supports affected by gender-based violence (GBV), including referral, psychosocial support, and linkage to legal and health services, and sustainable livelihoods for 100 beneficiaries.
